EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong phenyl ring-breathing doublet at ~1005 and 1032 cm⁻¹ typical of alkylated benzenes, plus two C–H out-of-plane bands at 821 and 749 cm⁻¹ consistent with a 1,3,4-trisubstituted ring (para + one ortho), rather than a monosubstituted pattern. The band at 624 cm⁻¹ supports an aryl C–Cl stretch, and the 1205 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with a phenolic C–O stretch. Aromatic (3064, 1609/1588 cm⁻¹) and aliphatic C–H stretches (2938, 2921, 2879 cm⁻¹) match an ethylated phenyl. Together these features best fit CCc1cc(O)ccc1Cl.
